net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util

Interface ResultSetWrapper.Factory

  • Enclosing class:
    ResultSetWrapper<T>

    public static interface ResultSetWrapper.Factory

    Each ResultSetWrapper implementation will need at least one Factory implementation. The Factory class is used to decide:

    1. Whether a given type can be constructed by the ResultSetWrapper
    2. If the parameter Map given is valid for the requested Type

    Factories can be registered using the ServiceLoader class, or by hand using the ResultSetWrapper.addFactory method. When deciding which Factory to use, the ResultSetWrapper will look backwards through the list of registered Factory objects. This means that the Factory added last has the highest priority.

    • Method Detail

      • isTypeConstructable

        boolean isTypeConstructable(Type genericType,
                            Map<String,Object> parameters)
                     throws InvalidQueryException

        Tests to see if this Factory object can build a ResultSetWrapper that will produce implementations of the requested type. This method may also validate any generic parameters, and the parameters in the parameter Map against any rules that it needs followed.

        If the Factory cannot produce an implementation because the genericType is wrong, or another Factory will be able to, this method should simply return false.

        If however: the Factory would normally be able to construct the implementation, but there are contracts or rules violated by the parameters (ie: a DataSet being requested as updatable and disconnected), this method should throw an Exception to indicate the violation.

        Implementations of Factory must be thread-safe.

        Parameters:
        genericType - the description of the type that should be returned from by the ResultSetWrapper.wrap(net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.Context) method
        parameters - the parameter Map holding additional information for the ResultSetWrapper object
        Returns:
        true if this Factory can create a ResultSetWrapper for the given type and parameter Map
        Throws:
        InvalidQueryException - if the type or parameters violate a contract of this Factory object

      • create

        ResultSetWrapper create(Type genericType,
                        Map<String,Object> parameters)
        Request that a ResultSetWrapper be created for the given type and parameters. This method will only ever be called after a call to isTypeConstructable(java.lang.reflect.Type, java.util.Map) returns true when given the same parameters.
        Parameters:
        genericType - the generic type to wrap
        parameters - the custom parameters for the ResultSetWrapper
        Returns:
        a valid ResultSetWrapper based on the type and parameter Map, never null
